correctness.rationale: On the line with bounded initial constant m, the plane-wave ansatz gives G'=g and H'=G^2; exact subflows produce right endpoint R and left endpoint L. For arbitrary positive h_j with q_0=q_N=0, integration and summation by parts give R-I=E+J and L-I=E-J. Independent exact arithmetic for h=(1,2,1), q=(0,2,1,0) gives I=19/3, R=6, L=9, so right splitting underattenuates. The interior q_i can be chosen arbitrarily, proving order equality for all echoes iff every neighboring h_i agrees. Explicit expansion gives 3(R-I)=v^T T_R v and similarly T_L, and the irreducible tridiagonal PSD criterion uses all strict proper leading minors and a nonnegative last determinant, with the stated recurrence. This covers N=2 boundary, all real echo gradients, and all positive durations; it does not imply a general full-solution or non-echo convergence theorem.
